title: Experimental fault-tolerant code switching
authors: Pogorelov, Butt, Postler, Marciniak, Schindler, Müller, Monz
conversion_notes: The archive's circuits.zip generates Qiskit experimental circuits; translate gates, measurements and feedforward to extended Stim, including the logical T implementation for the morphed 10-qubit code. Exact gate decomposition and conversion have not been checked.
notes: Verified author-released 5.8 kB circuit archive; explicitly Qiskit, not verified Stim. Experiment switches between Steane and morphed [[10,1,2]] codes. Paper describes native non-Clifford logical T; archive gate content unverified. Publication https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-024-02727-2. Year is arXiv first release; published 2025.

title: Stabilizer Code-Generic Universal Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation
conversion_notes: Inspect src/stim_experiments/circuits and Cirq universal_t implementations; translate the latter to extended Stim or combine the relevant Stim QEC component with the encoded T protocol. No specific proxy replacement has been verified.
notes: Author repository explicitly contains Stim circuit builders for QEC simulations and separate Cirq universal logical T experiments, with tetrahedral and Steane codes supported. It is unverified whether the Stim generators include a complete T gate protocol; ancillary-mediated approach is adjacent to code switching, not the same protocol.

title: High-threshold decoding of non-Pauli codes for 2D universality
authors: Magdalena de la Fuente, Feldman, Eisert, Bauer
conversion_notes: Reconstruct the non-Pauli syndrome-extraction circuit from the paper and its released simulation code, translating the relevant CCZ/CS/T circuit operations into extended Stim and preserving just-in-time corrections. No Stim generator or simple gate replacement verified.
notes: Paper explicitly links repository; its README describes cubic-lattice JIT decoder data generation and twisted-error simulation, not a Stim circuit export. Related to JIT decoding for universality but not a 2D-to-3D color-code switch.

title: Qubit CSS codes with Universal Transversal Gates
conversion_notes: Reconstruct from ancillary code and gate descriptions, including seed-based T/T_DAG layers or CCZ, and the paper's syndrome-extraction schedule. Not a verified ready-to-run Stim circuit.
notes: The article simulates stabilizer projections in Stim and constructs universal codes using 15-qubit Reed–Muller and 3D color-code seeds. Ancillary JSON is a code/gate database, not verified circuit files; no public simulation circuit generator found. Include only as reconstruction lead.
